package logsagent

import (
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"sync/atomic"
	"time"
)

var faultCalls atomic.Int64

func FaultCall() func() {
	if !FaultEnabled("completion") {
		return func() {}
	}
	faultCalls.Add(1)
	return func() {
		FaultMark("completion_finished")
		faultCalls.Add(-1)
	}
}

func FaultFinalDrain() {
	if faultCalls.Load() != 0 {
		panic("drain finalized before synchronous export calls finished")
	}
	FaultMark("drain_finalized")
}

func FaultEnabled(name string) bool {
	root := os.Getenv("OTEL_LOGS_FAULT_DIR")
	if root == "" {
		return false
	}
	_, err := os.Stat(filepath.Join(root, name+".hold"))
	if err != nil && !os.IsNotExist(err) {
		panic(err)
	}
	return err == nil
}

func FaultMark(name string) {
	root := os.Getenv("OTEL_LOGS_FAULT_DIR")
	if root == "" {
		return
	}
	file, err := os.CreateTemp(root, name+"-*")
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	if err := file.Close(); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
}

func FaultPause(name string) {
	if !FaultEnabled(name) {
		return
	}
	FaultMark(name + "_entered")
	for FaultEnabled(name) {
		time.Sleep(5 * time.Millisecond)
	}
	FaultMark(name + "_released")
}
